original_goal:
[Module: Login | TC-011 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Locked-out user receives locked-out error

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/login
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "locked_out_user",
  "password": "secret_sauce"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Login page; user is not authenticated; a locked-out user account must exist in the seeded data

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter 'locked_out_user' in the Username field
  2. Enter 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
  3. Click the Login button

Expected Result:
  Error banner is shown: "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out."; form does not submit; user remains on the Login page

Notes from prior verification:
  TC dropped because the required locked-out user record is not present in the mock database and cannot be created via the app in a test run. Steps unchanged otherwise.
